summary: INLIF Limited, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a previously approved share capital reorganization. The September 15, 2026 extraordinary general meeting adopted special resolutions reducing the par value of each class A and class B ordinary share from US$0.32 to US$0.0001 via cancellation of US$0.3199 of paid-up capital, with the credit moved to a distributable reserve, and adopting an eighth amended and restated memorandum and articles. The Cayman Registrar registered the minutes on September 28, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or management change is involved; this is a routine capital-structure mechanic.
